text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss 
also gazes into you." The divide between 
me and my sworn rival is just such an 
abyss.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am her "destiny." She is my "trial." It 
seems this was written into the script 
before we were even born.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We made a vow to each other: to stay true 
to who we are. The heavens turn, summer 
ends, and the Tenno Sho (Autumn) arrives.
